title: 单色预处理改进DSATUR图着色算法
summary: 提出SSLD方法，通过半定规划（SDP）预处理首个颜色类，再交由DSATUR完成剩余着色。在1600多个基准实例上，SSLD几乎全部匹配或超越DSATUR，并优于朴素预处理基线，但运行时间约为DSATUR的195倍。
summary_en: The paper proposes SSLD (Semidefinite Spectral Learning with DSATUR), which improves DSATUR by preprocessing a first good color class via Semidefinite Programming before letting DSATUR complete the coloring. Evaluated on over 1600 benchmark instances, SSLD matches or beats DSATUR in almost every case and outperforms a naive preprocessing baseline, at a runtime cost roughly 195 times slower than DSATUR.
